purpose: Professional logo exploration for Father's Business Bible Study

sharedDirection.redemptionAccent: Restrained burgundy bookmark rather than literal blood imagery

candidates.decision: Theologically clear but too ornate for the primary application icon.
candidates.prompt: Create an original Christian Bible study emblem centered on a dignified pulpit supporting an open Bible; the Bible's center gutter and the pulpit upright form a clear cross in negative space; a small simple crown rests above the cross. Use deep forest green, parchment white, aged brass gold, and one restrained burgundy-red ribbon accent. Transparent background, no text, no initials, no literal blood, no compass or north star.

candidates.decision: Selected as the primary project mark for its professional simplicity, theological clarity, and small-icon recognition.
candidates.prompt: Create an original minimal emblem showing an open Bible resting on a simple pulpit; carve a bold cross into the pulpit face as clean negative space; add a very small three-point crown directly above the cross, visually subordinate to the Bible. Use broad flat vector-like geometry, deep forest green, parchment white, muted antique gold, and one narrow burgundy-red bookmark. Transparent background, no text, no realistic materials, no literal blood, no compass or north star.

candidates.status: Rejected direction retained for review history
candidates.decision: The glow and literal drop make the mark feel more decorative and less durable than candidate B.
candidates.prompt: Create a compact emblem in which an open Bible forms the base, a simple upright cross rises from its center, and a small restrained crown sits above the cross; suggest a pulpit through a broad geometric base. Use deep forest green, parchment white, muted aged gold, and a small enclosed burgundy-red atonement accent. Transparent background, no text, no gore, no compass or north star.
